_read_me: Little Kettle Valley town plan. Anchor-relative [dx,dy,dz]; dy=0 is the levelled pad top course and everything stands at dy=1. GENERATED by tools/scripts/plan_town.py from the installed template NBTs - re-run it, never hand-edit, and re-run it after any change to BUILDINGS/STREETS/RESERVED in that script. The same run writes pack/kubejs/server_scripts/town_plan.js, which is the file the pack actually reads.

style.fallbacks: Towns and Towers - exclusives/classic (church, library, well, farms)
style.inn: Dungeons and Taverns - tavern/tavern_house_spruce (the only standalone tavern piece)
style.starting_ruin: Dungeons and Taverns - wild_ruin/wild_ruin_23 (self-contained, has a furnace)
style.works_interior: Dungeons and Taverns - bunker/* inside the sealed Works shell

cross_set_borrows_needing_sign_off.why: the only real windmill in any installed pack; sunflower_plains_farm set, oak/spruce palette, reads rustic-Swiss
neither meadow_swiss nor classic has a barn; rustic is spruce + brick trim

custom_builds: the Town Square paving, kerb and streets
the Harvest Supper table (Handcrafted furniture, not a template)

ground_rules.pad: clear dy1..h air, dirt dy-10..-2, coarse_dirt dy-1, top course dy0
ground_rules.template_y: every chosen template has its walkable floor at local y=y_base, so the place origin is dy = -y_base and the floor lands on the pad top course
ground_rules.markers: jigsaw blocks are cleared; Towns-and-Towers cyan_concrete street markers are replaced with the gravel/stone_brick mix kaisyn:village/street_meadow produces
ground_rules.apron: every door gets a 3-wide cobble/gravel apron routed to the nearest paving, and a lantern on a post beside it

inn.label: The Hearth
inn.blurb: Marnie keeps the fire in the middle.

mill.label: The Broken Mill
mill.blurb: Sixty years looking at a snapped axle.

marnie_house.label: Marnie's Cottage
marnie_house.blurb: Four years of watching a cold chimney.

granary.label: The Granary
granary.blurb: Twelve alcoves, one winter to fill them.

garden.label: The Hedge Garden
garden.blurb: Halden's rows. The quiet corner of town.

store.label: Oda's Store
store.blurb: Eleven years of ledger, no stock.

church.label: The Bell Tower
church.blurb: Pip gets to ring it. Marnie said.

town_hall.label: The Town Hall
town_hall.blurb: Fifteen people, arguing in the warm.

newcomer_tess.label: Tess's House
newcomer_tess.blurb: Empty until spring. Not empty now.

newcomer_mab.label: Mab's House
newcomer_mab.blurb: Beds made before they got here.

newcomer_corin.label: Corin's House
newcomer_corin.blurb: The last of the three empty houses.

bathhouse.label: The Bathhouse
bathhouse.blurb: Waste heat, into the town not the sky.

reservations_3d.name: works_shell
reservations_3d.why: the Works is a sealed dry room six blocks down; a pad that digs to dy-10 through its wall floods it and washes the lever off
